Name: X-Plane
Author: Robert Wellinger

Actions.Name: Command
Actions.Tooltip: Trigger any X-Plane CommandRef by path.

Actions.Name: Command + Display
Actions.Tooltip: Fire an X-Plane CommandRef on press; show a live DataRef as the title (e.g. G1000 softkeys).

Actions.Name: Guarded Command
Actions.Tooltip: Two-stage button: short press fires command A (e.g. open cover), long press (≥500 ms) fires command B with hold / auto-repeat (e.g. engage starter).

Actions.Name: Guarded DataRef
Actions.Tooltip: Two-stage DataRef button: short press toggles the guard DataRef 0↔1 (open cover), long press (≥500 ms) toggles the guarded DataRef (function on/off). Three visual states reflect locked / unlocked-off / unlocked-on.

Actions.Name: Rotary
Actions.Tooltip: Fire a CommandRef (optional begin/end HOLD on last enum position) and show a live DataRef value as title. For magneto, frequency tuning, FMS knobs, AP setpoints.

Actions.Name: Rotary DataRef
Actions.Tooltip: Increment/decrement a DataRef by a fixed step on each press. LEFT/DOWN subtract, RIGHT/UP add. Optional Min/Max clamp and long-press coarse step. For setpoints (HDG/ALT bug, BARO) where no matching CommandRef exists.

Actions.Name: Encoder
Actions.Tooltip: Stream Deck+ dial: rotate / click / shift. DataRef step (linear or octal) or CW/CCW commands. Live value on the touch strip.

Actions.Name: DataRef Display
Actions.Tooltip: Show a live X-Plane DataRef value as the button title.

Actions.Name: Display Selector
Actions.Tooltip: Hold a named index (1..N) that other buttons substitute for {KEY} in their DataRef/Command paths. Short press = next, long press = previous.

Actions.Name: Multi DataRef Display
Actions.Tooltip: Show up to 3 live DataRef values stacked on one button (COM A/S, Wind DIR/SPD/TEMP, …).

Actions.Name: Wind Display
Actions.Tooltip: Show wind direction as a rotating arrow plus wind speed (and optional OAT).

Actions.Name: DataRef Write
Actions.Tooltip: Write a fixed value to an X-Plane DataRef on press. Optional hold mode writes a release value on key release (e.g. test/reset buttons).

Actions.Name: DataRef Switch
Actions.Tooltip: N-position switch driven by a single DataRef. Short press steps toward Max (current + Step); long press (≥500 ms) steps toward Min. Stops at the configured Min/Max ends — perfect for 3-pos cockpit switches like AW109 cargo lights.

Actions.Name: DataRef Toggle
Actions.Tooltip: Two-state DataRef button: image follows live value, click toggles via write or command. Hold Mode turns it into a momentary press/release (test/reset buttons). Set State DataRef to read the visual state from a different DataRef than the one written on press (e.g. indicator lamp vs reset button).

Actions.Name: Multi-Action / Macro
Actions.Tooltip: Run an ordered list of commands / DataRef writes / delays on press (and optionally on release). Optional toggle mode runs an on-list / off-list alternately; the button image follows a state DataRef. One step per line: cmd <path>, begin <path>, end <path>, write <path>[idx] = <value>, delay <ms>.

Actions.Name: DataRef Lamp
Actions.Tooltip: Colored indicator lamp driven by a DataRef value. Lights up (blue / green / yellow / orange / red) when the DataRef matches the configured Value On; dark otherwise. Read-only.

Actions.Name: Background Tile
Actions.Tooltip: Decorative tile with no action — for visual separators and background fills.

Description: Control X-Plane 12 from your Stream Deck via the native Web API.
